prompts.product:
Use case: infographic-diagram. New publication-quality Chinese product architecture for LearnBuddy. Portrait 2:3, highest native detail. Warm white background, deep teal and restrained amber, crisp large Chinese type, clean flat vector-like infographics. Density through useful structured relationships, no robot mascots, no fake screenshots, no decorative building. Essential goal: a nontechnical reader instantly distinguishes the learning product, personal assistant and IM channel.
Title exact "LearnBuddy 产品架构"
Subtitle "网页里系统学习，飞书里随时对话"
Top compact experience band: "用户体验" then "定目标 → 测基础 → 学习练习 → 复盘调整".
Then TWO clearly distinct pathways:
LEFT top box "Web 学习空间", secondary "看计划 · 学课程 · 做练习".
RIGHT top box "飞书 · IM 入口", secondary "发消息 · 收回复 · 收提醒".
Directly BELOW right box, a prominent amber outlined box "OpenClaw · 个人学习助理", secondary "理解意图 · 读取上下文 · 调用工具". Right entry and OpenClaw connected bidirectionally labeled "对话". This node carries the personal assistant, Feishu does not think and does not store learning plans.
Under these two paths a full-width deep teal system container "LearnBuddy · 学习系统". LEFT Web has a clearly separate direct bidirectional connection to this container that BYPASSES OpenClaw. Right OpenClaw connects bidirectionally to this container with label "受控学习工具".
Inside LearnBuddy two clearly partitioned rows:
"学习服务" : "评估与规划" "教学与练习" "复习与调整" "提醒规则".
"学习数据" : "目标与画像" "计划与任务" "记录与进度".
Below system a clear small explanation "计划和进度保存在 LearnBuddy，不在飞书里另建一份".
Bottom mode bands separated WITHOUT interconnecting arrows:
"Cloud · 网页限额体验"
"Personal · 自有部署，可选 OpenClaw + 飞书"
Footer "个人飞书链路仍待真实验收".
Visually make the direct Web path and mediated Feishu→OpenClaw path unambiguous. Do NOT add direct Feishu→database arrows. No arrows between Cloud and Personal. Main core typography readable at mobile article width. Product overview only; leave backend API details for another image.
prompts.system:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a precise Chinese technical flow architecture infographic for LearnBuddy, portrait 2:3, highest native resolution, sharp large Chinese type, warm white background with deep teal and restrained amber. Reader is non-engineer learning AI Builder; label each technical component with its plain-language job.
Title "个人学习助理，怎样执行一句话？"
Subtitle "对话执行与定时提醒，是两条链路"
Upper majority: a vertical primary path made of 4 wide well-spaced boxes and clearly labeled bidirectional connectors:
1 "飞书 · IM 收发" secondary "你说：每天 21 点提醒我学习"
2 "OpenClaw · 助理运行时" secondary "理解请求 → 读当前规则 → 选择工具"
3 "受限 MCP · 工具接口" secondary "可信身份绑定 · 参数和归属校验"
4 "LearnBuddy · 执行与保存" secondary "set_reminder_policy → 写入提醒规则"
At the right of OpenClaw box a small clean attached note "模型 API" / "理解与组织回复", connected to OpenClaw only, not to storage or scheduler.
At the right of LearnBuddy box a clean storage note "SQLite / JSON" / "计划 · 记录 · 提醒规则" connected bidirectionally to LearnBuddy only.
Include a compact left side branch labeled "Web 页面 → FastAPI", arrow joining LearnBuddy service, to establish the same backend not another private truth store. Clear no crossing connectors.
A bracket/return annotation along primary path saying "按工具结果回复：已保存 / 未完成". Make return reach Feishu, not skip all context.
Below, a visually separate teal-bordered horizontal or bent flow lane titled "到了约定时间，不需要再发消息":
"LearnBuddy 调度器 → 投递队列 → 飞书提醒"
Connect persisted reminder rules to this lower lane with a thin clearly labeled arrow "到期规则". This lower lane does NOT pass through OpenClaw or model API.
Footer two clear notes:
"OpenClaw 不直接改数据库，也不重复调度提醒"
"Personal 方案 · 工具底座已有，真实渠道待验收"
No extra modules, no fake trace/logs, no claims of successful live delivery. Use restrained icons and clean connectors, prioritize true architecture and human-readable jobs. Keep tiny implementation names limited to set_reminder_policy, all other labels comfortably large.

Fill only that removed connector/label area with the matching ivory background. Keep ALL main vertical request and return arrows between Feishu, OpenClaw, MCP and LearnBuddy intact. Keep the Web→FastAPI branch and its arrow intact. Keep every other word, panel, icon, title, model API and SQLite node, reminder lane, dimensions, colors and layout unchanged. The correct response already travels up the main chain. No new labels or connectors.
